description: The file defines the EmployeeEventService class in the OrangeHRM project, providing methods for managing employee events such as saving, updating, and retrieving event records. It uses traits for user role management and date-time helpers, and interacts with DAO and entity classes related to employee events.

classes.name: EmployeeEventService
classes.description: Service class providing business logic for managing employee events, including creation, updating, and retrieval of employee event records with role-based user context.

methods.name: getEmployeeEventDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and retrieves the EmployeeEventDao instance used to access employee event data in persistence.

methods.name: setEmployeeEventDao
methods.description: Sets the EmployeeEventDao instance, allowing for dependency injection or mocking.

methods.name: saveEmployeeEvent
methods.description: Persists an EmployeeEvent entity using the DAO.

methods.name: saveEvent
methods.description: Creates and saves an EmployeeEvent with specified details and the current user role and timestamp.

methods.name: getEmployeeEvents
methods.description: Retrieves a list of EmployeeEvent entities matching the specified search filter parameters.

methods.name: getUserRole
methods.description: Retrieves the current user's role name or defaults to 'System' if no user context is available.

methods.name: saveAddEmployeeEvent
methods.description: Convenience method to save a generic employee addition event.

methods.name: saveUpdateEmployeePersonalDetailsEvent
methods.description: Convenience method to save an event indicating employee personal details update.

methods.name: saveUpdateJobDetailsEvent
methods.description: Convenience method to save an event indicating employee job details update.
